reasons: Judged from the seven renders only. A, B and C look identical: smooth shading, no labels, the same two views. D and E look identical: a voxel grid with no labels, and a dark bounding-box wire drawn across the tower. F and G look identical: a voxel grid, labelled 'Front, from south-east' and 'Back, from north-west' as the brief's render checklist asks, and no wire artefacts. Ranked first: F, because it matches the brief's two-view layout and labels and shows the cube structure cleanly. Second: A, which has clean, polished shading and the same silhouette as the others (16 high, 10-wide walls, 12-wide eave, stepped spruce roof, four windows, path with two lanterns, darker base band), but no labels and no visible cube grid. Third: D, which has the same geometry and colours as F, but the dark wire lines cut across the walls and roof and read as a rendering artefact. Ties within each identical group are broken arbitrarily. All seven show the apex, the eave, the path and lanterns, and the back windows. None shows the quoins, chiseled band or cracked cells clearly enough to separate the options.
